title: Titanium Pocket Comb
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is chosen for Titanium Pocket Comb where scratch resistance (hardness 36 HRC) and premium tactile feel differentiate the user experience. Its thermal conductivity (6.7 W/mK) is 85% lower than aluminum, reducing heat transfer to the skin surface in handheld devices. The alpha-beta microstructure enables thin-wall CNC profiling to <0.5mm wall thickness while maintaining structural rigidity under 3-point bending — essential for Premium titanium pocket comb. This rationale is driven by premium titanium pocket comb and service environment demands.
process: CNC milling HSM 30k RPM for edc geometry
Tumble finish ceramic media with Class 6g gauge
PVD TiN/TiCN coating with Class 6g gauge
Optical Keyence inspection with Class 6g gauge
surfaceTreatment: PVD TiAlN coating (2-3um, HV2500 hardness) for scratch resistance and uniform gunmetal aesthetic finish — tailored for premium titanium pocket application
commonFailures: Wear-through of surface after 5000 insertion cycles - mitigated by PVD TiAlN 3um HV2500 coating — critical for premium titanium pocket performance

faq.q: What drop-test performance can I expect from Titanium Pocket Comb?
faq.a: Titanium Pocket Comb fabricated from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V with 0.8-1.2 mm wall thickness typically survives 1.5 m drop onto concrete (per IEC 60068-2-31) without permanent deformation when designed with ≤0.5 mm edge clearance to internal components. The 830 MPa yield strength provides a 3-5× safety margin over the impact stress for premium titanium pocket geometries.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Pocket Comb orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Pocket Comb is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Pocket Comb?
faq.a: Each Titanium Pocket Comb shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for premium titanium pocket.
